title: Configure store details and checkout defaults
prerequisites: Approved store identity and support details; snapshot original settings before an isolated demonstration.

scenes.title: Find the workflow
scenes.narration: Store settings contains the core values used by checkout and new orders. Open Store settings. Use approved store and support details so customer-facing information is accurate and your team can receive enquiries.

scenes.title: Understand the controls
scenes.narration: Review store name, support email and support phone. Configure a three-letter currency code and the supported order-number prefix. The reservation duration controls how long a new checkout can hold stock; choose a value that fits your operation.

scenes.title: Perform the task
scenes.narration: Enable checkout when the store is ready to accept orders. If pausing it, write a clear checkout notice. Disabling checkout does not hide the entire storefront. Save settings and wait for confirmation.

scenes.title: Verify and continue
scenes.narration: Reload the page to confirm persistence, and verify a supervised checkout where relevant. Core settings are not editable home-page body content. Page SEO has its own draft and publication workflow below these settings.
